notes.title: No Plan B Steam Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=d64hiezzkZ0;full][/previewyoutube]

🗓️ Mark your calendars for [b]April 3rd[/b], as that's the day when [b]No Plan B 1.0[/b] (the full game) will officially release on Steam!

[u]Also, don't forget to add the game to your wishlist:[/u]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1269020/No_Plan_B/

V1 will be packed with all the features and improvements that have been implemented during its early access phase:

[list]
[*] [b]Roguelike Campaign[/b]
[*] [b]Single Missions[/b], including daily/weekly/monthly Challenges and a Mission Generator
[*] [b]Survival Mode[/b]
[*] Unlockable [b]Weapons, Grenades and Ballistic Shields[/b]
[*] [b]Character Progression[/b] system
[*] Character and Weapon [b]Customization[/b]
[*] [b]Multi-Storey Buildings[/b] and their deadly stairs
[*] [b]Map Editor[/b] with thousands of assets
[*] [b]Mod Support[/b] + [url=https://mod.io/g/noplanb]more than 80 custom missions, weapons and skins[/url]
[*] [b]Steam Achievements[/b]
[*] And tons of other gameplay features like sniping, crouching, perks, exterior maps, new objectives, etc.
[/list]

...plus a few extras for the release:
[list]
[*] [b]New Squad Options[/b]: all game modes unlocked right from the start, maxed character XP and a god mode!
[*] [b]New Character Voices[/b]: the good guys will get the female counterpart alongside the recent male update and the bad guys will join in with both male and female voices.
[/list]

But that's not all!

Also launching on [b]April 3rd[/b], a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2324620/No_Plan_B__Supporter_Pack]"Supporter Pack" DLC[/url] will introduce fancy [b]new character customization options[/b] to boost the [i]tacticoolness[/i] of your squad and make your mission replays even more epic.
Check out the new possibilities on the dedicated page:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2324620/No_Plan_B__Supporter_Pack

Please note that purchasing this DLC primarily demonstrates your support for the game and the customization options showcased above don't provide any gameplay advantages.
[u]Be sure to add it to your wishlist if you are interested![/u]

This DLC will integrate the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/23899/No_Plan_B__Supporter_Edition/]"Supporter Edition" bundle[/url], so players who already purchased the bundle will automatically receive the DLC on release day.

[b]Everyone sync their timeline on April 3rd![/b]
